name: a2uicatalog-a2h-printer
description: a2uicatalog a2h Printer — the signed-image-render mechanism (the "printer") that lets a2uicatalog content reach any chat host. Self-hosted mode: a Slack/Teams/Chat bot deployers run on their own infrastructure, no a2uicatalog.ai account, no data leaves the deployer's container. See copilotkit/ for the hosted, agentic CopilotKit Channels mode.
